en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Магија сторила' is a birth-time charm so that suitors will circle the girl; 'нашата' shortened as 'наш'та'. Mostly clear, no major guesses.

lines.cyr: Дотекла вода студена, леле оф аман,
lines.lat: Dotekla voda studena, lele of aman,
lines.en: Cold water came flowing, oh woe, oh mercy,

lines.cyr: роди се Јана убава, леле оф аман,
lines.lat: rodi se Jana ubava, lele of aman,
lines.en: beautiful Jana was born, oh woe, oh mercy,

lines.cyr: Кога се Јана родила, леле оф аман,
lines.lat: Koga se Jana rodila, lele of aman,
lines.en: When Jana was born, oh woe, oh mercy,

lines.cyr: мајка ѝ магија сторила, леле оф аман,
lines.lat: majka ì magija storila, lele of aman,
lines.en: her mother did a magic spell, oh woe, oh mercy,
she threw a live chick into the fire.

lines.cyr: Како што се врти пилето, леле оф аман,
lines.lat: Kako što se vrti pileto, lele of aman,
lines.en: As the chick turns, oh woe, oh mercy,

lines.cyr: така да се вртат ергени, леле оф аман,
lines.lat: taka da se vrtat ergeni, lele of aman,
lines.en: so may the bachelors turn, oh woe, oh mercy,
